verdict.rationale: QuickBooks offers relevant building blocks — Intuit Intelligence AI chat that can 'help resolve anomalies' and reconciliation discrepancy/missing-checks reports, plus a first-party MCP server exposing 29 entity types and 11 financial reports for agent read access — supporting an agent-driven anomaly-flagging workflow. However, there's no explicit evidence of continuous ledger monitoring, automated duplicate-transaction detection, or a 'flag before close' workflow tailored to multi-entity audits. Missing for 10: dedicated duplicate-transaction detection feature, proactive/continuous monitoring loop tied to close process, and independent evidence the MCP/AI anomaly resolution actually works in practice.
